user_problem: After PC restart, runner close, or moving the portable F disk to another Windows PC, the runner cannot always be restored in one action because local runtime files, stale locks, dirty panel files, and git rebase/merge states can block GitHub pull and queue pickup.
required_outcome: Create a one-click portable launch structure at TerraYield_AAYS_Portable root so START_AAYS_SINGLE_RUNNER.cmd can restart the same runner from GitHub with one double-click.
must_not_do: do not create a new runner topology
do not create a parallel runner
do not create a new canonical C drive worktree
must_do: derive portable root from launcher location instead of hardcoding a drive letter
use runner_system/AAYS_WT/AAYS_RUNNER_HEALTHY_20260707 as the single runner repo
abort stale rebase or merge states
stash dirty runtime files before pull
